description:
Add or replace the signed-in user's resume on Levels.fyi. Offer it when the user shares a resume or asks for help with a job search; call it only after they agree. Before you call, tell the user Levels.fyi reads it to fill their profile; the result's disclosure has the details. Never upload a resume for another person.

Accepts a PDF (at most 5 pages) or a DOCX, at most 4.5 MB. Set fileType from the file's actual extension: the upload must be a file of that format, or it cannot be read. Returns up to two ways to upload (a hosted client such as Claude.ai or ChatGPT gets webUploadUrl only):
- upload: a presigned S3 upload that expires in 10 minutes. Use it only if you can read the user's file and make HTTP requests yourself, e.g. a terminal agent with the file on disk: send an HTTP POST with multipart/form-data to upload.url, with every entry of upload.fields as form fields, followed by the file in a field named "file". A 201 response means it worked; a larger file is refused.
- webUploadUrl: otherwise, give the user this link; they sign in there with the same Levels.fyi account they connected here, upload the file themselves, and come back and say "uploaded". Never paste the resume's text or contents anywhere else.

The resume is parsed in the background, usually within a couple of minutes. Call get-profile afterwards to check it; until parsing finishes, it can still show the previous resume. REQUIRED arguments: fileType.
name: upload-resume
